title: merge --review-record records the round 3 that a fix check leaves owed
why: R9 (retrospective relay, 16:07 CST Nov 10): a guard change fixed under a fix check owes round 3. merge --review-record refuses that record: rounds must rise 1, 2, 3, and a fix check is not round 2. Hit twice on 2026-11-10: #2570 (round 1 PASS, fix check PASS, round 3 PASS net positive) and #1338 (round 1 FAIL, fix check PASS, round 3 PASS net zero). Neither round 3 is on its record, so the batch runner cannot see it. Either the tool takes a round 3 after a fix check, or R9 is rewritten to match the tool; one record of the rule either way (step rounds-rules-one-record).
